meta.name: lark-workflow-standup-report
meta.description: 日程待办摘要：编排 calendar +agenda 和 task +get-my-tasks，生成指定日期的日程与未完成任务摘要。适用于了解今天/明天/本周的安排。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动汇总日程与待办，生成每日工作摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要快速了解当日日程和未完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Automatically summarize calendar and tasks for daily standup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick daily summary of your schedule and pending tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据指定日期（如今天、明天、本周）获取用户的日历日程和未完成任务，并汇总成一份包含日程表、待办列表、冲突检测和空闲时段的摘要报告。
howto.when: 当你询问“今天有什么安排”“明天的日程和待办”“生成站会摘要”等，或要求查看指定日期的日程与任务时触发。

say.note: Claude 会生成今日日程和待办摘要。

say.text: 明天的日程和未完成任务

say.note: Claude 会输出带冲突检测和空闲时段的摘要。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can retrieve your calendar events and incomplete tasks for a specified date (e.g., today, tomorrow, this week) and compile a summary report including a schedule table, to-do list, conflict detection, and free time slots.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about today's, tomorrow's, or this week's schedule, request a standup summary, or inquire about tasks and events for a specific date.

say_en.note: Claude generates today's agenda and task summary.

say_en.text: Show tomorrow's events and pending tasks.
say_en.note: Claude produces a summary for tomorrow.

say_en.text: Generate a standup report for today.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a summary with conflict detection and free slots.
